note: Teal first-floor room of big numbers with a running-track floor (cartoon style). Landmark: the three-step sports podium (premier gold cup, deuxième silver, troisième bronze) with dernier, the last runner, darning his sock beside it. Front row: trente (boy with a long toy train), cinquante (sinking toy boat with a giant ant), cent (girl building a sandcastle surrounded by about a HUNDRED little sand buckets), mille (a meal of a thousand peas), le million (lion on a mound of gold coins, masculine, right). Zooms: the long grey table (tens 40-90, approximate numbers, milliard) and the pie counter (fractions). The doorway at the back left leads to the stairs down to the pronouns hall; the red door on the right leads to the second pronouns room.
